# Automation and CI/CD Pipelines

Our platform includes end-to-end automation pipelines connecting scheduled orchestration, continuous integration testing, and documentation publication.

## Scheduled Workflows with n8n

We automate recurring model evaluations using [n8n](http://localhost:5678):

```
Schedule (Sundays 02:00) / Webhook Trigger
                    ↓
       python3 scripts/run_all_benchmarks.py
                    ↓
       python3 scripts/make_all_reports.py
                    ↓
       git commit artifacts & push
                    ↓
       Post-Run Webhook Notification
```

### Workflow Specification
- **Configuration File:** `n8n/uc12-benchmark-workflow.json`
- **Default Schedule:** Weekly execution on Sundays at 02:00 local time.
- **On-Demand Webhook:** `POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/uc12-benchmark-trigger`

To trigger an immediate evaluation run without waiting for the scheduled cron:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/uc12-benchmark-trigger
```

### Environment Settings in n8n
Configure operational settings within n8n under Settings -> Variables:

| Variable | Value Description | Purpose |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `WEBHOOK_NOTIFY_URL` | Outbound webhook URL | Dispatches completion summaries to Slack, Teams, or email |
| `LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN` | OAuth bearer token | Enables direct automated posting of generated research briefs |

## Continuous Integration via GitHub Actions

Our repository maintains automated workflows in `.github/workflows/`:

### 1. Script Validation (`validate.yml`)
Runs on every push to `main` and on pull requests affecting `scripts/**`:
- Installs Python 3.11 and dependencies (`matplotlib`, `numpy`, `requests`).
- Executes `python -m py_compile` across all evaluation scripts.
- Parses abstract syntax trees (AST) to verify import integrity without triggering compute overhead.

### 2. Quarto Book Publishing (`deploy-book.yml`)
Deploys this interactive documentation book to GitHub Pages:
- Installs the Quarto publishing CLI via `quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2`.
- Renders the complete book into static HTML, JavaScript, and SVG assets.
- Pushes the rendered bundle to the `gh-pages` branch via `peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4`.

## Docker Containerization

To run reproducible evaluations in isolated container environments, the platform provides Docker definitions:

```bash
# Launch CPU-bound evaluation stack
docker compose up -d

# Launch GPU-accelerated evaluation stack with NVIDIA container runtime
docker compose -f docker-compose.gpu.yml up -d
```

The container stack mounts local model weights and output directories while exposing ChainForge on port 8765.
